422_ap_missing_input_edge.description: Raised when the operator has no outgoing 'input' edge pointing to the seed dataset ID.

value.error: Malformed AP Graph: No input dataset linked to the Recommender Operator. Expected edge direction: Operator --input--> seed dataset.

422_ap_missing_operator.description: Raised when the DatasetRecommender_Operator node is completely missing from the graph.

value.error: Malformed AP Graph: Operator 'DatasetRecommender_Operator' not found.
